reply.text: {"say":"Side delts lead the day with three different lateral raise variations, backed by one overhead press for the standard work and an upright row to finish the width.","title":"Shoulder Day: Width Focus","days":[{"name":"Shoulder Day","exercises":[{"key":"dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":4,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with elbows, stop at shoulder height.|Control the lowering.|No swinging.|Slight forward lean.|Pinkies level with thumbs.|Pause at the top.|Light and strict.|Smooth tempo.|Squeeze at top.|Keep traps down.|Elbows slightly bent.|Steady reps.|Full range.|Stay tall."},{"key":"cable-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Cable from behind, constant tension at the bottom."},{"key":"seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows slightly forward, press to lockout."},{"key":"machine-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause at the top for a full second."},{"key":"leaning-dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hold the post, raise out to the side."},{"key":"cable-upright-row","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Wide grip, pull elbows high and out."}]}],"unmet":[]}
